Description:
IntAsphalt delivers a field-tested, sensor-driven AI system for very high-accuracy prediction of black ice and road-surface freezing.

Our product combines on-site road-surface sensors, environmental sensors, an IoT gateway, AI prediction software, a monitoring dashboard, and actionable alerts. By connecting regional weather information with live conditions from the surface itself, IntAsphalt provides site-specific intelligence for the locations where freezing risk matters most.

The system supports two deployment paths:
• Prediction, dashboard, and alerts for operational decision support.
• Prediction-informed integration with sub-asphalt heating controls for sites requiring active mitigation.

IntAsphalt also provides heating-system concept development, zone strategy, control logic, and integration advisory. Final site-specific engineering, paving, electrical installation, and construction are delivered through qualified local partners.

The connected system has been field-tested through an initial pilot deployment in Iran and is available for qualified site deployments and technical evaluations.

The integrated technology is the subject of an international patent application filed under the Patent Cooperation Treaty on August 16, 2025 — Application No. PCT/IB2025/058311.

IntAsphalt is based in Winnipeg, Manitoba, Canada.

Name: Innova Cleantech Corp.
Description:
What if there was a way to decarbonize the world’s most carbon-intensive industries by replacing methane combustion, which releases harmful CO2 emissions, with a pre-combustion carbon capture process that transforms the gas into two products vital to the energy transition: clean graphite and hydrogen?

Innova is doing just that.

Innova has developed a revolutionary technology that takes abundant, inexpensive methane (CH4) from natural gas or biogenic sources, and by applying heat and a catalyst, splits it into its constituent components of carbon (C) and hydrogen (2H2). The liberated carbon adheres to the catalyst in the form of graphite, leaving a hydrogen byproduct.

Innova’s process uses no water or oxygen. It produces no CO2. 

The graphite can be sold as a valuable raw material, or undergo further processing for a multitude of applications such as soil remediation, concrete, steel, and battery manufacturing. 

The hydrogen co-product, along with any unreacted methane, can be used or sold as a low-carbon fuel, or purified for use as an industrial feedstock or for clean power generation. 

Innova's “plug & play” system is modular, scalable and ties seamlessly into existing infrastructure to enable rapid deployment and flexible, decentralized, industrial siting. 

Innova is on a mission is to accelerate the energy transition and secure energy independence by replacing methane combustion with a pre-combustion carbon capture solution that offers localized “greener & cleaner” graphite and hydrogen at a lower cost than incumbent methods of production, which are time-, cost, energy-, and emissions-intensive. 

Innova Cleantech is revolutionizing decarbonization with cleaner materials and fuels today for a cleaner tomorrow.

159.71 million buildings must be decarbonized by 2050 in North America alone, and the demand for renewable engineering services is growing. To decarbonize, built environment stakeholders require pre-feasibility studies that provide technical, actionable, and bankable insights to create renewable energy solutions that de-risk and maximize asset value.

They face three problems: 

Access to the technical details required to develop renewable projects
Access to a scalable resource that can meet the demand for renewable projects
Access to regularly-updated data that maintains relevance across each project’s timeline

In short, there is a bottleneck. Traditional engineering services cannot address the magnitude of the problem. 

The Solution:

OVR-VU, powered by Rathco: an engineering software, born from Rathco’s deep renewables expertise, that automates pre-feasibility studies and scales the built environment’s energy transition.

By combining the rigor of engineering with the power of software automation, OVR-VU produces dynamic pre-feasibility studies that identify optimal scenarios for levelized cost of energy, GHG emissions, capital costs, and operational costs, and updates them based on changing market conditions.

OVR-VU provides an optimized energy recommendation, as well as an actionable pathway to implementation, to de-risk, streamline, maximize asset value, and decarbonize the built.
